summary: In All comments, a suggestion's thread says what the review did with the suggestion: Suggestion accepted, Suggestion rejected, Suggestion accepted and rejected, or Suggestion deleted, also after a reload. Show in document opens only a suggestion that is still pending, and not while a preview shows the document.
